mapper.select: SELECT ORG_ID, ORG_NAME, PARENT_ORG_ID, CASE USE_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ACTIVE_FLAG FROM PM_ORGANIZATION ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, ORG_ID
SELECT USERNAME, CURRENT_ORG_ID FROM PM_USER_PROFILE WHERE ENABLED_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY USERNAME
SELECT AUTHORITY_ID, AUTHORITY_NAME, CASE ACTIVE_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ACTIVE_FLAG FROM PM_AUTHORITY ORDER BY AUTHORITY_ID

SELECT USERNAME, ORG_ID, AUTHORITY_ID, ASSIGNMENT_TYPE, ASSIGNMENT_STATUS, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO, DELEGATED_BY, HISTORY_SEQ FROM PM_USER_AUTH_HIST ORDER BY USERNAME, AUTHORITY_ID, ASSIGNMENT_TYPE, HISTORY_SEQ

SELECT MENU_ID, PARENT_MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, MENU_PATH, SORT_ORDER, MENU_AREA, CASE ACTIVE_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ACTIVE_FLAG, CASE DISPLAY_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DISPLAY_FLAG, CASE PUBLIC_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PUBLIC_FLAG FROM PM_MENU ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, MENU_ID
SELECT AUTHORITY_ID, MENU_ID FROM PM_AUTH_MENU ORDER BY AUTHORITY_ID, MENU_ID
SELECT PROGRAM_ID, PROGRAM_NAME, NVL(DESCRIPTION, '') AS DESCRIPTION, SCREEN_CODE, CASE ACTIVE_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ACTIVE_FLAG FROM PM_PROGRAM ORDER BY PROGRAM_ID

SELECT MENU_ID, PROGRAM_ID, ACTION_ID, ACTION_NAME, COMPONENT_ID, SORT_ORDER, CASE ACTIVE_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ACTIVE_FLAG FROM PM_PROGRAM_ACTION ORDER BY MENU_ID, PROGRAM_ID, SORT_ORDER, ACTION_ID
SELECT AUTHORITY_ID, MENU_ID, PROGRAM_ID, ACTION_ID FROM PM_AUTH_ACTION ORDER BY AUTHORITY_ID, MENU_ID, PROGRAM_ID, ACTION_ID
SELECT DOMAIN_CODE, VERSION_NO FROM PM_DOMAIN_VERSION WHERE DOMAIN_CODE IN ('AUTHORITY', 'MENU', 'PROGRAM_ACTION')
mapper.update: MERGE INTO PM_AUTHORITY target USING DUAL ON (target.AUTHORITY_ID = #{authority.id}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.AUTHORITY_NAME = #{authority.name}, target.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y''N', target.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( AUTHORITY_ID, AUTHORITY_NAME, ACTIVE_YN, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{authority.id}, #{authority.name}, 'Y''N', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSTEM' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PM_USER_AUTH_HIST ( ASSIGNMENT_ID, USERNAME, ORG_ID, AUTHORITY_ID, ASSIGNMENT_TYPE, ASSIGNMENT_STATUS, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO, DELEGATED_BY, HISTORY_SEQ, REASON, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( SQ_PM_USER_AUTH_HIST.NEXTVAL, #{assignment.username}, #{assignment.organizationId}, #{assignment.authorityId}, #{assignment.type}, #{assignment.status}, #{assignment.validFrom}, #{assignment.validTo}, #{assignment.delegatedBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{assignment.sequence}, NULL, 'SYSTEM' )
mapper.update: MERGE INTO PM_MENU target USING DUAL ON (target.MENU_ID = #{menu.id}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.PARENT_MENU_ID = #{menu.parentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, target.MENU_NAME = #{menu.name}, target.MENU_AREA = #{menu.area}, target.MENU_PATH = #{menu.path,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, target.SORT_ORDER = #{menu.sortOrder}, target.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y''N', target.DISPLAY_YN = 'Y''N', target.PUBLIC_YN = 'Y''N', target.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( MENU_ID, PARENT_MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, MENU_PATH, SORT_ORDER, MENU_AREA, ACTIVE_YN, DISPLAY_YN, PUBLIC_YN, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{menu.id}, #{menu.parentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{menu.name}, #{menu.path,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{menu.sortOrder}, #{menu.area}, 'Y''N', 'Y''N', 'Y''N', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSTEM' )

MERGE INTO PM_AUTH_MENU target USING DUAL ON (target.AUTHORITY_ID = #{authorityId} AND target.MENU_ID = #{menuId}) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (AUTHORITY_ID, MENU_ID, CREATED_BY) VALUES (#{authorityId}, #{menuId}, 'SYSTEM')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PM_AUTH_MENU WHERE AUTHORITY_ID = #{authorityId} AND MENU_ID = #{menuId}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO PM_PROGRAM target USING DUAL ON (target.PROGRAM_ID = #{program.id}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.PROGRAM_NAME = #{program.name}, target.SCREEN_CODE = #{program.screen}, target.DESCRIPTION = #{program.description}, target.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y''N', target.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PROGRAM_ID, PROGRAM_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SCREEN_CODE, ACTIVE_YN, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{program.id}, #{program.name}, #{program.description}, #{program.screen}, 'Y''N', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSTEM' )

MERGE INTO PM_PROGRAM_ACTION target USING DUAL ON (target.MENU_ID = #{action.menuId} AND target.PROGRAM_ID = #{action.programId} AND target.ACTION_ID = #{action.actionId}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.ACTION_NAME = #{action.label}, target.COMPONENT_ID = #{action.componentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, target.SORT_ORDER = #{action.sortOrder}, target.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y''N', target.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( MENU_ID, PROGRAM_ID, ACTION_ID, ACTION_NAME, COMPONENT_ID, SORT_ORDER, ACTIVE_YN, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{action.menuId}, #{action.programId}, #{action.actionId}, #{action.label}, #{action.componentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{action.sortOrder}, 'Y''N', 'SYSTEM', 'SYSTEM' )

MERGE INTO PM_DOMAIN_VERSION target USING (SELECT #{domainCode} AS DOMAIN_CODE FROM DUAL) source ON (target.DOMAIN_CODE = source.DOMAIN_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.VERSION_NO = target.VERSION_NO + 1, target.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DOMAIN_CODE, VERSION_NO, UPDATED_BY) VALUES (source.DOMAIN_CODE, 2, 'SYSTEM')
mapper.select: SELECT MENU_ID FROM PM_FAVORITE_MENU WHERE USERNAME = #{username} ORDER BY CREATED_AT, MENU_ID
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PM_FAVORITE_MENU WHERE USERNAME = #{username} AND MENU_ID = #{menuId}
